Name: Custom NPC Paintings
Author: AvalonMFX
Description:
This mod allows you to easily create highly customisable paintings of NPCs. Select the frame, background and NPC of your choice. Additionally, feel free to adjust the position and frame of the NPC such as the offset of the background. For even more customisation, you can [b]add [/b]your[b] own frames [/b]and [b]backgrounds[/b]!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/K2wE19M.png[/img]

[list]
[*]10 Frames
[*]26 Backgrounds
[*]Any NPC (even modded and optionally monsters, pets, ...)﻿ including Farmer (only local one, multiples in multiplayer are currently not supported)
[*]Custom backgrounds & frames. Here's a[url=https://github.com/1Avalon/Avas-Stardew-Mods/blob/main/CustomNPCPaintings/README.md] [/url][url=https://github.com/1Avalon/Avas-Stardew-Mods/blob/main/CustomNPCPaintings/README.md]guide[/url]﻿ on how to add your own ones
[*]single colored backgrounds with color sliders
[*]adjust HSV of NPCs and background for people who play with recolor/desaturation mods
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/n9k82K7.png[/img]

[list]
[*]After obtaining a [u]catalogue[/u], you can find a [u]button[/u] below your money component﻿ in the catalogue menu
[*]Clicking on that button opens the menu where you can customise your painting
[*]Exporting a painting [u]is free[/u] and does [u]not cost any gold[/u]
[*]The mod will fetch the current sprite from your NPC of choice. If it's winter, you can only access the winter sprite of the NPC (because it's the current one). The same applies for any other cases
[*]If you don't see the button in the catalogue, you can set a hotkey for opening the menu. I recommend doing that using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿﻿. Make sure to be in a location with a catalogue placed down somewhere. There will also be a reminder if you're using known mods that unintentionally remove the button
[*]Since there is no direct way to access the Farmer sprite, the mod will draw its frames, screenshot it and process it further (this feature can be disabled tho)
[/list]
[youtube]Krq3wprie2c[/youtube]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4E3zYtL.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Search and filter functions
[*]Overlays (snow, rain, ...)
[*]save presets in order to use them on other saves
[*]get existing paintings
[*]non rectangular frames
[*]way more frames and backgrounds
[/list]

[u][img]https://i.imgur.com/W1gSYfd.png[/img][/u]

[list]
[*][color=#93c47d]Compatible with modded NPCs﻿: [/color]Any modded NPC is automatically supported (for instance: SVE, RV, Aspen, ..)
[*][color=#93c47d]Compatible with Windows and Mac[/color]
[*][color=#93c47d]Multiplayer compatible[/color]
[*][color=#93c47d]Compatible with Happy Home Designer: [/color]Happy Home Designer offers a feature to create custom paintings within it's menu. The hotkey won't be removed in the next update but the message about setting a hotkey.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Some frames of NPCs (for example when they're fishing) only show the fishing rod. The mod just accesses the sprite sheet of the NPCs but doesn't process it further﻿
[*]The slider works when using mouse wheel or the arrow buttons. However, you can not drag the runner
[*]Farmer sprites are partly bugged. This is an experimental feature though.
[*]the sprites of farmers children are bugged on first stage (baby)
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mEnyAyC.png[/img]

[b]Q: Is this mod compatible with mod ... ?[/b]
A: The mod should be compatible with most mods. It doesn't patch any line of code means there should be very little to zero conflicts with other mods. If you can't access the original UI of the catalogue, you can set a hotkey in the config and open the customiser by pressing it. A catalogue must be in your current location though.

[b]Q: Does this work with modded NPCs?[/b]
A: Yes! You can create a painting of any modded NPC that is able to socialize. The mod automatically fetches the NPCs so there will be no work for custom NPC authors.

[b]Q: Can I add custom backgrounds and frames?[/b]
A: Absolutely! There are two different ways on how to add them. It's explained [url=https://github.com/1Avalon/Avas-Stardew-Mods/blob/main/CustomNPCPaintings/README.md]here[/url].

[b]Q: I want to use the winter outfit for my NPC. How can I do it?[/b]
A: The mod fetches the current sprite of each NPC. If you want to use the winter sprite, you have to wait until its winter. This applies for any other case (Beach, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outifts[/url] during the corresponding season, ...)
